borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Change of use of the dwelling (C3a) to a children's home (C2) for up to four children aged 8-17
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The proposed development results in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. Furthermore, the applicant fails to accurately demonstrate that there&nbsp;is an identified need for the children's home,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">which&nbsp;would not meet the current needs of LBBD Children’s Social Care, according to&nbsp;LBBD's Lead Commissioner in Children's Social Care</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">. As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's supply of family housing and is contrary to the following policies:&nbsp;</span></p><ul><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024) </span><br></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policiy&nbsp;D7, H1, H12 and S2 of the London Plan (March 2021) </span><br></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policies SP3 and&nbsp;SPDG1 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></li></ul>

<p>The applicant&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">has failed to&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">confirm the presence of a lawful vehicle crossover or apply for one through the appropriate highways process,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">and has failed to provide sufficient evidence that the proposal will not result in unacceptable levels of parking stress in the vicinity</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">.&nbsp;</span>As such, it fails to comply with the following policies::</p><ul><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024)</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policies T1, T2, T4, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></li></ul>
